textual.context: The ASR presents this as a network-building opportunity and an instruction to participants; it does not independently establish whether the price claim, mining activity, packages, or outcomes are genuine.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed increase in coin value is directly linked to recruiting additional miners and bringing packages into the business, which may require later assessment of the recruitment and financial-participation structure.
textual.limitations: The records do not define the packages, state their price or terms, identify any recipient of funds, or establish actual market value, participant outcomes, or transactions.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin mining packages and urges viewers to recruit new miners as a way to increase the coin's market price. It presents collective recruitment as the mechanism for creating value, telling the network to bring packages into the business and build networks rather than merely reporting on or criticizing the offer. The promotional framing is reinforced by repeated OneCoin and Forbes imagery.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because participation is tied to mining packages and expected coin-value gains, with the video encouraging viewers to enter the mining business and recruit additional miners.
